summary: Verified public API and mobile web flow for DD-MM-YYYY blueprint calculation, Jakarta selection, results, back navigation, language toggle, and invalid dates.

minor.issue: ISO date 1990-01-01 is accepted with 200 despite the required DD-MM-YYYY-only contract. Invalid 31-02-1990 correctly returns 400.

action_items: Reject non-DD-MM-YYYY dates in the backend instead of falling back to datetime.fromisoformat.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend result correctly renders only Type, Authority, and Profile; unused planet styles/data remain in the component but do not affect the requested UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://birth-chart-app-17.preview.emergentagent.com. 01-01-1990 / 12:00 / Jakarta returned Projector, Mental, 4/6. City picker, back button, language toggle, and hidden strategy/planet details passed.
rca_of_issue: calculate_blueprint first parses DD-MM-YYYY but catches ValueError and then accepts ISO via datetime.fromisoformat. Remove the ISO fallback or validate the date format before parsing so malformed/noncanonical input returns a friendly 400.
